product: Ravenloft: Strahd's Possession — enhanced native PC port
current_distribution: Owner confirmed uninterrupted Windows launch through character creation into Level 22 on artifact from build #819; first Level 22 audiovisual/rendering/gameplay quality remains unaccepted.

stages.label: Continuous opening to first playable Level 22
stages.scope: A one-click, audiovisual native Windows start through two-person character creation into a visually correct and controllable Level 22; no DOS hardware parity required.

gates.name: Opening cinematics and sound
gates.pass_when: Cold native Windows play shows complete CINE00/CINE12 with recognizably correct frames, music, effects, speech, stable playback and responsive skip behavior without audio stutter.
blocked_by: The one-click Windows build has not passed an owner-observed uninterrupted cinematic and audio test.

gates.name: DreamForge, SSI and TSR splash screens
gates.pass_when: All DreamForge, SSI, TSR and related logos appear in the intended order, fade smoothly, have stable visual presentation and lead directly to the game title.
blocked_by: The real player-facing startup has not been accepted for its logo ordering, display scaling and fade quality.

gates.name: Responsive animated game title
gates.pass_when: Native title artwork, animated background, correct card and cursor states, menu highlights and navigation remain responsive and readable at supported window sizes.
blocked_by: The full native title flow has not passed owner acceptance for animation, menu input and rendering.

gates.name: Usable title actions without false success
gates.pass_when: Replay intro, new game and exit operate from the real title. An unfinished Load Game action must be clearly unavailable without corrupting state; functional loading is a Beta goal.
blocked_by: No owner Windows test confirms all currently supported title actions; save loading remains unavailable.

gates.name: Smooth complete two-person character creation
gates.pass_when: A real new game lets users create two characters, including choices, names, portraits, stats, animations, the lady and cat, correct card-flip direction, synchronized sound and cancel/edit flow.
blocked_by: The previously functioning creation and animation baseline has not been reaccepted in the continuous package.

gates.name: Reliable character creation to game-state transfer
gates.pass_when: Created characters enter the native level with correct names, classes, stats, portraits and equipment; a party can be carried forward without requiring a byte-for-byte original DOS CHARS ABI.
blocked_by: Owner confirms native character-creation path reaches Level 22; exact transferred party names, stats, equipment and ongoing state have not yet been inspected in the current build.

gates.name: Visually complete Level 22 starting scene
gates.pass_when: Character creation seamlessly loads the authored Level 22 with visible ground, sky, distance, trees, assassin NPC, HUD, proper palette/composition and no blank viewport or flashing.
blocked_by: Owner confirms Level 22 loads but reports issues; current sky, ground, background, tree/assassin sprites, frame pacing and HUD need visual evidence and defect triage.

gates.name: Usable first-level controls and interaction
gates.pass_when: In the resulting Level 22, movement, turning, collision, camera frame pacing, basic NPC interaction and essential UI respond reliably to standard Windows keyboard and mouse.
blocked_by: Smooth normal-input gameplay, usable frame pacing and first interactions have not been accepted on Windows.

gates.name: Reproducible one-click Windows Alpha artifact
gates.pass_when: A pinned Windows x64 build passes relevant automated regressions and publishes a self-contained native launcher with verified bytes, legal original-media setup and no recurring mode picker.

gates.name: Owner accepts continuous playable Level 22 Alpha
gates.pass_when: Owner completes a single-launch Windows test from cinematics, logos, title and two-person creation to a visibly correct and responsive Level 22 scene with audio, then accepts that Alpha scope.
blocked_by: Owner confirms continuous Windows launch into Level 22, but does not yet accept the level's visual/audio quality, controls or first gameplay encounter; Alpha field acceptance remains pending.

stages.label: Full campaign playable with native saves
stages.scope: The complete authored campaign from title to ending on Windows, with functional mechanics, transitions and safe port-native save/load.

gates.name: Start-to-ending playable campaign
gates.pass_when: A normal native Windows new game can progress through the complete original authored campaign to its ending using in-game controls, with no developer teleport or synthetic bypass.
blocked_by: The full authored campaign and end-to-end scripted progression remain unimplemented and untested.

gates.name: Every authored level, quest and transition
gates.pass_when: All required levels, authored routes, quests, triggers, encounters, character/NPC placements and transitions function continuously; scenery and level identities are recognizable.
blocked_by: Complete Level 22 story and subsequent authored level transitions have not passed end-to-end testing.

gates.name: Complete PC-port gameplay rules
gates.pass_when: Class and character rules, party state, movement, combat, statuses, inventory, equipment, rest, time, XP, and scripted world interactions remain coherent across campaign.
blocked_by: Cross-level gameplay rules and systems are incomplete and need integrated field tests.

gates.name: Complete usable magic and rest
gates.pass_when: Spellbook/prayer/memorization and casting, effects, durations, targeting, defenses and recovery work throughout the full authored campaign on Windows.
blocked_by: Live magic, leveling and rest systems have not been accepted for the full campaign.

gates.name: Reliable NPC and enemy behavior
gates.pass_when: Authored NPCs and monsters appear and behave coherently in exploration and combat; movement, attacks, deaths, drops and event triggers preserve intended encounter design.
blocked_by: NPC encounters and combat behavior remain partially reconstructed and unaccepted in live gameplay.

gates.name: Safe complete-game native saves
gates.pass_when: Users can save, exit, relaunch and restore every required party, inventory, script, quest, level, NPC and world-state change safely using a versioned PC-port format.
blocked_by: Native-port save/load round trips and safe persistence have not been implemented across the campaign.

gates.name: Complete authored graphics, audio and animation
gates.pass_when: Original authored backgrounds, sky, terrain, architecture, sprites, cutscenes, speech, sound and music render and play across all campaign levels without major missing assets.
blocked_by: Rendering, animation and sound still have missing or unaccepted real-game paths.

gates.name: Robust Windows input, menus and failure paths
gates.pass_when: All required game menus and controls work reliably, including load/save, options, resume and quit; bad files and unsupported state yield safe errors instead of data corruption.
blocked_by: Several modal menus, save/load actions and error paths are incomplete or have not been field tested.

gates.name: Full Windows Beta build and long-play regression
gates.pass_when: The exact-source Windows release candidate passes all required native tests and complete campaign smoke tests, uses original files lawfully and can restart from port-native saves.
blocked_by: No exact-source full-game native Windows Beta build or complete-campaign playback exists.

gates.name: Campaign-breaking defects resolved
gates.pass_when: No known reproducible issue prevents finishing the game or irreversibly corrupts saves; remaining cosmetic and enhancement defects are tracked for final polish.
blocked_by: Campaign-blocking features and known first-level rendering issues remain unresolved.

stages.label: Polished enhanced native PC release
stages.scope: A stable, polished, feature-complete Windows PC port with full original authored content and optional modern conveniences, not a DOS re-execution.

gates.name: Stable gameplay and coherent rules
gates.pass_when: Complete-game testing confirms repeatable party, AI, combat, magic, quest and world state through saves, restarts, transitions and major optional branches.
blocked_by: The complete game is not yet implemented, balanced or validated in long-play Windows testing.

gates.name: Polished modern rendering and display
gates.pass_when: The entire game renders correctly with stable motion, properly layered environments/sprites, readable interface and configurable aspect-correct windowed/fullscreen scaling.
blocked_by: The native viewport currently has known visual defects, and modern display options are unfinished.

gates.name: Smooth animation, input and performance
gates.pass_when: Cinematics, lady/cat/card animations, world frame rate, controls and combat perform smoothly on supported PCs; no DOS timer/IRQ/VGA refresh imitation is required.
blocked_by: Native pacing, input responsiveness and representative performance have not been accepted on Windows.

gates.name: Polished speech, music and sound settings
gates.pass_when: Voice, music and sound effects play correctly throughout the game with clean mixing, reliable devices and usable master/music/SFX volume controls.
blocked_by: Complete-game audio, device reliability and independent mixer controls are not yet accepted.

gates.name: Safe portable PC save and load behavior
gates.pass_when: Port-native saves and loads preserve the complete campaign state after restart and version upgrades, resist corrupt files and avoid overwriting original installed games.
blocked_by: Versioned safe port saves, restoration and corruption handling are incomplete.

gates.name: All original authored levels and ending content
gates.pass_when: All required world maps, NPCs, creatures, spells, equipment, puzzle logic, story scenes, quests, endings and supporting assets are reachable in the native port.
blocked_by: Full campaign content, secondary branches and ending coverage remain incomplete.

gates.name: Intentional enhancements and robust recovery
gates.pass_when: Modern host errors, missing resources and invalid saves are handled without destructive original DOS quirks; remaining gameplay deviations are documented and regressions fixed.
blocked_by: Safe failure handling and documented intentional gameplay deviations need integrated validation.

gates.name: Stable reproducible enhanced PC build
gates.pass_when: The pinned Windows release passes native automated and real-play regression, produces a checked executable/artifact, and works with supported media layouts and hardware.
blocked_by: No release-quality enhanced native Windows candidate has passed complete build and owner review.

gates.name: Safe distribution and accessible player setup
gates.pass_when: Player installation and asset-import instructions are clear; user supplies authorized originals; public artifacts exclude unlicensed assets and include controls, options and known limitations.
blocked_by: Final packaging, original-media setup and usability documentation have not been audited.

gates.name: Owner acceptance of finished enhanced PC port
gates.pass_when: Owner approves a repeatable native Windows start-to-ending playthrough with functional saves, audio, graphics, controls, modern usability options and no critical defects.
blocked_by: The enhanced Windows game is not yet complete or accepted as a release.
